prompt:
Our quant research team has years of accumulated notes, strategy docs, and session logs scattered across various folders (old_memory/research/, old_memory/strategies/, old_memory/risk/, old_memory/raw_logs/). The current MEMORY.md at the workspace root is a useless mess of TODO comments and dead links.

We need you to restructure the entire knowledge base using the three-tier memory architecture described in the skill documentation at skill/SKILL.md. Specifically:

1. Migrate all the research/strategy/risk markdown files into the appropriate tiered location.
2. Migrate all session logs into the correct tiered location, organized by year-month.
3. Completely rewrite MEMORY.md as a proper master index — it must list every topic you migrated, using the exact table format specified in the skill documentation, with importance scores assigned based on how critical each topic appears to be.
4. Configure the overnight auto-consolidation system to run at 22:30 (instead of the default time), with the feature enabled. The configuration file should be placed in the user-level config location described in the skill documentation.
